# MenuVision AI

> Snap a photo of any menu and instantly see what every dish looks like — translated into your language, with ingredients and dietary tags.

MenuVision AI is a web app for travelers and curious eaters. Open the site, take a photo of a menu, and get every dish explained in your language with real food photos. No app download, no sign-up required.

For restaurant owners, MenuVision AI turns a printed menu into a permanent, shareable, translated menu page with a QR code. Guests scan the code and browse dishes in their own language with photos.
